name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 80% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff offset. This balances visibility for keyboard users with subtle design—high enough contrast to stand out against most backgrounds but low enough opacity to avoid visual noise. The trade-off is slightly reduced prominence for users with low vision who rely on high-contrast focus indicators, but WCAG 2.2 only requires *some* visible focus, and this meets it without overwhelming the interface.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 80% opacity still fails WCAG 2.1 AA on dark backgrounds—contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 4px ring at 100% opacity with a 2px inner offset meets AA everywhere, including touch screens where fingers obscure smaller rings. Test it on a dark background with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation suite to confirm.
